crossRefs.note: Give sincere homage to the Son, lest he be angry, and you perish on the way, for his wrath will soon be kindled.…
Oh taste and see that Yahweh is good. Blessed is the man who takes refuge in him.
Trust in him at all times, you people. Pour out your heart before him. God is a refuge for us.
Happy is he who has the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in Yahweh, his God:
who made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them; who keeps truth forever;
Therefore Yahweh will wait, that he may be gracious to you; and therefore he will be exalted, that he may have mercy on…
Who among you fears Yahweh and obeys the voice of his servant? He who walks in darkness and has no light, let him trust…
“Blessed is the man who trusts in Yahweh, and whose confidence is in Yahweh.
For he will be as a tree planted by the waters, who spreads out its roots by the river, and will not fear when heat…

translations.web: Yahweh of Armies, blessed is the man who trusts in you.
translations.bsb: O LORD of Hosts, how blessed is the man who trusts in You!
translations.kjv: O LORD of hosts, blessed is the man that trusteth
translations.asv: O Jehovah of hosts, Blessed is the man that trusteth in thee. Psalm 85 For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of the sons of Korah.
